digest.component_or_area: rebar.llm public API and external integration tests
propositions: The public API rebar.llm.review_ticket() was removed in a pre-1.0 breaking change and mapped to rebar.llm.review_plan() or rebar.llm.review_code(), but two external test modules (test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py and test_llm_trace.py) were not retargeted and still call the removed function.

Four CI lanes in the Live External Integration workflow (external LLM live anthropic, external LLM live openai, external LLM live bedrock, and langfuse tracing round-trip) fail with AttributeError: module 'rebar.llm' has no attribute 'review_ticket'.
External tests are excluded from the standard Verified gate, so the removal epic's test run never caught these two modules, making the regression invisible until a live workflow_dispatch execution.

The fix requires retargeting both test modules to rebar.llm.review_code (not review_plan) because review_code returns REVIEW_RESULT with runner/model/findings fields matching the tests' existing assertions, while review_plan returns PLAN_REVIEW_VERDICT without a top-level findings field.
